name: Mutsuzawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mutsuzawa town emblem in blue and green: an outlined blue ring enclosing a green stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Mutsuzawa, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 9 July 1973; the emblem dates from 20 June 1973.

features.role: Mutsuzawa town emblem — an outlined blue ring enclosing a green stylised mountain
